text:
Maria: PR #18111 — small routing fix + DB migration. CI is stuck on linux-e2e (timeout). Need 1 approving reviewer and a re-run. Can we try to land in the 1-hour rebase window before tonight's deploy-freeze?
Ryan: @Maria I can give it a quick review now. Is the DB migration backward compatible? If so, we can land to canary.
Sam: LGTM from the code side. Migration adds a nullable column, should be safe. :thumbsup:
CI-Bot: linux-e2e failed — flake: connection timeout during kube setup. Use `/ci rerun pr=18111 lane=linux-e2e` to requeue.
Maria: Thanks @Sam. @Ryan can you approve so I can request another rerun? If we miss the midnight deploy-freeze canary slot we have to wait ~8 hours.
Ryan: Approving now. Left a tiny nit about log verbosity but not blocking.
Alex: Re-ran the lanes: `/ci rerun pr=18111 lanes=linux-e2e,linux-matrix` — queued and will ping when jobs start.
Maria: If linux-matrix passes, I'll merge immediately and pin the canary. Can anyone on call escalate if matrix flakes?
Sam: I can jump on flakes. Also add this snippet to the migration rollout notes:```sql
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN new_flag BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE;
```
Maria: Jobs passed on matrix, merging now and kicking off canary. Thanks everyone! :tada:
